main_text.l: Quod verò ad Lapidem Philosophorum attinet, alia iucunda est via, siquidem duplex ejus præparandi ratio est, vel per compositionem radicis suæ mineralis simplicis cum resoluto auro, quem⸗morem[?] sequitur Basilius in 12.clavibus, vel per conjunctionem auri cum radicibus minerarū compositis, à qua via minimum recedit Lapis Ignis ex Mercurio antimonii & vitriolo Veneris atque Martis per propriū sulphur parandus. Sed de hujus genere satis supra diximus, à quo nihil differt descriptio parabolica de Nobili Solis flore, ex præcipuæ cujusdam Civitatis Imperii archivis non ita pridè (ut fertur) depromptâ, quæ totum processum abundè tradit, quamvis multorum Sophistarum

page.notes: The scan is cropped at the right and the word "quemmorem" at the line end is unclear; it is marked [?]. The "12." before "clavibus" is printed with a dot. Some letters in the lower lines are faint, so the accents on "verò", "pridè" and "depromptâ" are as far as they can be read. The show-through text on the right page edge is not transcribed.
